column1: # The objects of ff7.exe, in the order the retail linker saw them.
# source   the file that compiles to the object
# library  `explicit`: the object goes on LINK's command line, before every library (retail had 12).
#          Otherwise the static library it is a member of, one per source directory as the 1997
#          build had them. LINK searches the libraries in the order of their first row here, and
#          each library holds its members in row order.
# options  compiler switches this file needs beyond the common ones in tools/build.py
